scopeRule: Gas pipelines of LENGTH >= 25 km (transmission trunks, regional and inter-field trunks, branches and spurs alike; skip anything under 25 km and skip city and district distribution networks such as oblgaz and city gas utilities). If you cannot establish a length, still emit it and say 'length unknown'.
vetRule: (d) LENGTH RULE (Baird 2026-09-30): a qualifying new_row must be >= 25 km with a SOURCED length. Under 25 km, OR uncertain/unsourced length -> class monitor, monitor_reason 'length'. TERRITORY: follow docs/reference/gem_naming_conventions/ (occupied Ukraine incl. Crimea, Sevastopol, Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson oblasts = Ukraine; a line wholly inside occupied Ukraine is a Ukraine row, a line from Russia into it is a Russia-Ukraine cross-border row). An occupying-power operator is reported as the builder in notes, never as the Ukrainian operator. WINDOW: new announcements from the last ~3 years, plus operating/built lines GEM never captured. OSM and GulfPub are lead sources only, never a [ref].
extra:
## This run: Ukraine gas, whole country (47 GEM rows) plus cross-border lines with a Ukrainian end
The roster below is the FULL Ukraine roster plus cross-border rows. Match against all of it before calling anything new.
Window: announcements from the last ~3 years PLUS operating/built lines GEM never captured. Length rule: >=25 km only; uncertain length -> say so.
Territory naming follows docs/reference/gem_naming_conventions/ (occupied Ukraine = Ukraine).
Operator ladder: GTSOU (Gas Transmission System Operator of Ukraine, tsoua.com, 403s, read via Wayback), Ukrtransgaz (utg.ua, 403s, read via Wayback; storage and the pre-2020 trunk chronology), Naftogaz annual reports, Ukrgasvydobuvannya field lines, NEURC (energy regulator) TSO ten-year development plans, ENTSOG TYNDP project codes, EIB/EBRD project pages, and the neighbor TSOs (Gaz-System, Eustream, FGSZ, Transgaz, Vestmoldtransgaz, Moldovatransgaz via the mtg.md mirror). vtg.com.ua Soviet-era trunk table: live URL 404s, Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/20220608014635/http://www.vtg.com.ua/experience/main/gts.html?lang=ru serves it; its name cells carry rowspans, so read the grouping before attributing a spec. energybase.ru serves an IP-block page with HTTP 200; treat as blocked.
Thematic leads: regional trunks and branches >=25 km built or rebuilt by GTSOU/Ukrtransgaz since 2015 (gasification of oblasts, looping of Soviet trunks), Black Sea shelf field lines (Chornomornaftogaz: Holitsynske, Shtormove, Odeske, Arkhangelske fields to Hlibivka storage and onshore), Crimea lines (Dzhankoi-Simferopol, Hlibivka-Simferopol-Sevastopol stages, Dzhankoi-Henichesk), new lines in occupied Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson oblasts, EU interconnectors and their Ukrainian legs (Poland-Ukraine Hermanowice-Bilche Volytsia, Slovakia-Ukraine Budince-Uzhhorod, Hungary-Ukraine Beregdaróc, Romania-Ukraine Isaccea-Orlovka and Mediesu Aurit-Tekovo, Moldova Iasi-Ungheni-Chisinau links), the Trans-Balkan reverse flow and Vertical Corridor, and Ukrainian ends of retired Russian transit trunks.
Seed leads below are 23 GulfPub reference lines that matched no GEM row, plus 3 Ukraine-internal leads a Russia pass handed over. Verify each, and match it to an existing GEM row under another name before anything else.
Do not re-report the 62 GulfPub near-miss records; they are for hand adjudication.
